newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to sell high-voltage equipment maker ZWAR.
newsitem.headline: Poland to sell high-voltage equipment maker ZWAR.

text.p: The Polish privatisation ministry invited bids for up to 75 percent of the high-voltage equipment producer Zaklady Wytworcze Aparatury Wysokiego Napiecia ZWAR (Zwar), the ministry said in a newspaper announcement.
It said it invited bids for at least 10 percent stakes in the company, based in Warsaw, by September 17.
It said it earmarked up to 20 percent of the company's shares for employees and five percent for reprivatisation claims.

Zwar had a net profit of 1.8 million zlotys in the first 10 months of 1995 and 2.6 million zlotys from November 1995 to March 1996, on sales of 91.2 million zlotys and 54.5 million respectively, the company said in a statement.
